discovery: Discovery of glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) and its development into therapies for diabetes and obesity
rationale: GLP-1 work has swept the major precursor prizes (Lasker 2024, Breakthrough 2025, Gairdner, Princess of Asturias), has transformative clinical impact on diabetes and obesity, and fits the Karolinska pattern after immunology (2025) and RNA (2023-2024) prizes.
